desc: 婚宴派对长桌布置，纱布垂坠质感配烛光花艺场景
name: 婚礼宴会垂坠纱布桌旗款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净白底交代桌旗的垂坠褶皱形态
一秒讲清核心卖点，铺上就是一场婚礼宴会布置
代入真实家用餐桌场景，让买家想象自己铺开后的样子
展示长边垂地的瀑布效果与宴会厅纵深，撑起氛围价值
用稀疏纱织与褶皱肌理特写证明面料质感
同款多色并列供买家按宴会配色选款，降低选择成本
收口消除风险，交代到手形态与平整易收纳，留白承接后续主张

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF and warm ivory wall #F7F3EC grounds, with real light oak flooring kept in frame on the scene shots
style.direction: romantic boho banquet table styling ecommerce
style.iconSystem: none, no icon graphics in this visual system
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight from the left at 5000-5200K, low contrast, gentle fabric fold shadows and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent romantic boho banquet-styling visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory wall #F7F3EC, solid walnut table #7B4F35, brushed brass accent #C6A15B and charcoal text #3A3330, with the product tone always taken from the reference image; warm neutral overall; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for short optional callouts; no icon graphics; soft diffused daylight from the left around 5000-5200K, low contrast, gentle fabric shadows and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; matte walnut tabletop, light oak flooring and seamless ivory or white grounds; the runner is always laid along the table axis with at least one end cascading over the edge and pooling, combed into even vertical folds and never hidden under props; stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no glossy studio set replacing the walnut table and oak floor
no props covering the fabric surface
style.presentationRules: the runner is always laid along the table axis with at least one end cascading over the edge and pooling on the floor, folds combed into even vertical ridges, place settings flanking symmetrically, nothing laid on top of the fabric, stable scale and slight 3/4 or straight-on angle across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte solid walnut table #7B4F35, light oak floor #D8AC72, ivory linen or seamless white ground #F7F3EC
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, text-free on the marketplace main image, one thin weight only for optional short callouts
